entities.summary: Crest of the Stars  is a three-volume space opera science fiction novel written by Hiroyuki Morioka with cover illustrations by Toshihiro Ono. This was followed by a second, ongoing novel series, Banner of the Stars and a series of books collecting short stories set in the same universe known as Fragments of the Stars .
